title: CardioGuard - Model & Service Monitoring
description: Live service metrics (Prometheus), drift results (Evidently via Pushgateway + PostgreSQL) and self-healing (Phase 6).

target.rawSql: SELECT run_at AS time, 'Drift ' || status AS text, status AS tags FROM drift_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(run_at) AND status IN ('warning', 'critical') ORDER BY 1

SELECT at AS time, event || ' ' || coalesce(model_version, '') AS text, event AS tags FROM deployment_events WHERE $__timeFilter(at) AND event IN ('canary_started', 'promoted', 'rolled_back') ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Prediction API
panels.description: Can Prometheus reach /metrics? Alert: PredictionAPIDown after 1 minute.

panels.title: Requests / second
panels.description: All endpoints, last minute.

panels.title: Prediction error rate (5 min)
panels.description: Share of /predict* requests returning 5xx. Alert above 5% for 5 minutes.

panels.title: p95 prediction latency
panels.description: 95% of prediction requests finish faster than this. Alert above 500 ms for 5 minutes.

panels.title: Saving predictions
panels.description: Is the API writing predictions to PostgreSQL? Drift checks need this.

panels.title: Requests per second by endpoint
panels.description: From the recording rule cardioguard:http_requests:rate1m.

panels.title: Predictions per minute by risk level
panels.description: Low < 40%, moderate 40-70%, high > 70% predicted risk. A shift in the mix is an early sign of drift.

panels.title: Prediction error rate
panels.description: Dashed line: 5% alert limit (applies to 5xx). 4xx are invalid inputs rejected by validation.

panels.title: Prediction latency
panels.description: Whole request time, including validation. Dashed line: 500 ms alert limit for p95.

panels.title: Predicted risk distribution (last 15 min)
panels.description: How many patients got each predicted risk. Training data is roughly flat with peaks at both ends.

panels.title: Mean predicted risk
panels.description: About 50% in the training data (the dataset is balanced).

panels.title: Model and SHAP time (p95)
panels.description: Time inside the model only, without HTTP or logging. The gap to the request latency is overhead.

panels.title: Model version
panels.description: Champion loaded by the API (Phase 6: from MLflow).

panels.title: Confirmed diagnoses (1 h)
panels.description: Ground truth received via /feedback. The accuracy check needs about 100 per drift window.

panels.title: Invalid inputs rejected (1 h)
panels.description: Requests with impossible values (e.g. diastolic above systolic).

panels.title: Prediction log failures (1 h)
panels.description: Writes to PostgreSQL or MongoDB that failed.

panels.title: Systolic BP: live mean vs training
panels.description: Real-time view of systolic bp (mmHg). Shows a shift within minutes; the drift check confirms it statistically.

panels.title: Diastolic BP: live mean vs training
panels.description: Real-time view of diastolic bp (mmHg). Shows a shift within minutes; the drift check confirms it statistically.

panels.title: Age: live mean vs training
panels.description: Real-time view of age (years). Shows a shift within minutes; the drift check confirms it statistically.

panels.title: BMI: live mean vs training
panels.description: Real-time view of bmi. Shows a shift within minutes; the drift check confirms it statistically.

panels.title: Latest drift status
panels.description: Pushed by the drift job. Alerts: DataDriftWarning, DataDriftCritical.

panels.title: Retraining
panels.description: Critical drift in consecutive windows. Phase 6 retrains automatically.

panels.title: Highest PSI
panels.description: 0.10 moderate shift, 0.25 major shift.

panels.title: ROC-AUC (confirmed cases)
panels.description: On human-labelled rows in the last drift window. Training: 0.802.

panels.title: Last drift check
panels.description: Time since the drift job last ran. Alert DriftCheckStale after 2 hours.

panels.title: Drift per input (score ÷ threshold)
panels.description: 1 or more = drifted (red). Evidently: Wasserstein for numeric inputs, Jensen-Shannon for categories.

panels.title: Drift history
panels.description: One point per drift run, from the drift_runs table in PostgreSQL.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_at AS time, max_psi AS "Highest PSI", prediction_drift_score AS "Prediction drift", drift_share AS "Share of inputs drifted" FROM drift_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(run_at) AND status <> 'insufficient_data' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent drift checks
panels.description: Latest 20 runs from PostgreSQL. Open the monitoring page for the full Evidently report.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_at AS "Checked", status AS "Status", n_rows AS "Patients", n_labelled AS "Confirmed", round(drift_share::numeric, 2) AS "Inputs drifted", round(max_psi::numeric, 2) AS "Highest PSI", round(roc_auc::numeric, 3) AS "ROC-AUC", CASE WHEN retrain_recommended THEN 'Yes' ELSE '' END AS "Retrain", replace(reasons, E'\n', ' | ') AS "Reasons" FROM drift_runs ORDER BY run_at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Last pseudo-label run
panels.description: Runs after each drift check. Skipped while drift is critical: model confidence is unreliable then.

panels.title: Accepted last run
panels.description: Pseudo-labels added by the last run (after agreement filter, class balance and caps).

panels.title: Acceptance rate
panels.description: Accepted / unconfirmed patients. About 13% on normal traffic: the model is well calibrated, so it is rarely 90% sure. Alert LowPseudoLabelAcceptance below 5%.

panels.title: Methods disagree
panels.description: Share of unconfirmed patients where self-training and label spreading give different labels.

panels.title: Pseudo-labels stored
panels.description: Capped at 1x the real labels so machine guesses never outnumber real diagnoses.

panels.title: Pseudo-labelling over time
panels.description: From the pseudo_label_runs table. Watch for acceptance falling while disagreement rises.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_at AS time, acceptance_rate AS "Acceptance rate", disagreement_rate AS "Methods disagree", mean_confidence AS "Mean confidence" FROM pseudo_label_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(run_at) AND status = 'ok' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rollout
panels.description: From mlops/deployment.py. Approve or reject on the monitoring page.

panels.title: Traffic on candidate
panels.description: Share of requests the API sends to the candidate during a canary release.

panels.title: Candidate
panels.description: Model on trial. Empty when no rollout is running.

panels.title: Last pipeline run
panels.description: Outcome of the last cardio_self_healing run (Airflow or python -m mlops.pipeline).

panels.title: Since last run
panels.description: Time since the self-healing pipeline last finished.

panels.title: Requests per model version
panels.description: During a canary, about 10% of requests go to the candidate. After promotion it takes all.

panels.title: Model time p95 per version
panels.description: The canary check rolls back if the candidate is much slower than the champion.

panels.title: Self-healing events
panels.description: Latest 25 entries of deployment_events: training, checks, approvals, canary, promotion, rollback.

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS "When", event AS "Event", model_version AS "Model", registry_version AS "MLflow v", actor AS "By", left(detail::text, 300) AS "Detail" FROM deployment_events ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 25
